data.spiritual_significance: The name Devland carries a deep spiritual significance as it emphasizes the belief that the earth and all that is in it ultimately belongs to God. It calls Christians to recognize their dependence on God for the land they live on, and to use it as a means of glorifying Him. Devland can also serve as a reminder of God's promise to be with His people and to provide for them, as the land was a key aspect of God's covenant with His people in the Old Testament. Additionally, it can be seen as a call to stewardship, as Christians are entrusted with the care and management of the land God has given them.
